result:
I added `fee(order) -> int` in a new file, `/work/shipping.py`, which didn't exist before. It runs the nine steps in your order. I tested it against 30 hand-calculated cases (in `/tmp/shiptest/t.py`, kept outside the repo), and all of them pass. The cases cover each step and its edge points: base fee by region, the ValueError for an unknown region, box splitting, weight steps, free shipping (including islands), both coupons, member discounts, weekend and fragile surcharges, peak season (12/20, 12/31 and 1/1), and rounding up to 10원.

The spec was unclear in three places, so I made these calls:

- **"기본 요금 중 최저값" for islands:** I read this as the cheapest fee in the whole region table, 3,000원. So Jeju and Ulleung get (number of boxes × 3,000원) taken off, and the result never goes below 0.
- **Rounding the member discount:** I round down the fee after the discount, the same way as SHIP50. For example, silver on 2,250원 gives 2,137원. Rounding down the discount amount instead would give 2,138원. After the final round-up to 10원 the two almost always end up the same.
- **Days count by order date:** an order on 12/20 that falls on a weekend gets both the weekend 1,000원 and the 120% multiplier.

STATUS: DONE
